schema.description:
A formula that describes how emissions are calculated for a given Emission Inventory Category and a given Emission Calculation Method.

The formula provides the template for performing calculations for a given Emission Parameter Assignment.

The activities involved in the calculation are reflected in the components of the Formula; i.e., the Emission Calculation Formula Component.
schema.title: Emission Calculation Formula

standard_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Standard to which the Emission Calculation Formula conforms.

valid_to_datetime.description: The date and time to which the Emission Calculation Formula is valid.

valid_from_datetime.description: The date and time from which the Emission Calculation Formula is valid.

emission_activity_category_id.description: The Foreign Key for Emission Activity Category assigned to the Emission Calculation Model.

physical_quantity_type_id.description: Optional part of a composite Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment (the Physical Quantity Type).

emission_calculation_method_type_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Calculation Method Type.

emission_calculation_formula_id.description: The Primary Key of the Emission Calculation Model.

name.description: The name assigned to the Emission Calculation Formula.

description.description: Long description assigned to the Emission Calculation Formula.

emission_activity_type_id.description: Optional part of a composite Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment to which this Emission Calculation Formula belongs (the Emission Activity Type).

emission_parameter_assignment_id.description: Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Type Parameter Type Assignment used by this formula.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
